    Review handoff

    Preview saved decisions before exporting or submitting. File names, human notes and the marked AI layer titles and one-line layer summaries are included. Source bodies, per-item AI explanations, prompts and discussion transcripts are not included. Unsaved drafts are not exported.

    Portable state and reopening requirements

    JSON contains decisions and a reading point, not source or a canvas link. Open the original saved snapshot and import there. Commit reviews need the original Git objects; worktree reviews need the original saved worktree source. Import verifies exact content, never newer worktree files.

    Find in this review
    
            
        
    
        
        
        
    
        
      
        
      Searches this snapshot's file names, symbols, and findings—not full source text. Results are capped at 30.
      
        
      With review or source focus: J/K next/previous item, M mark the open file reviewed and go to the next, U switch unified/split diff (wide windows), C comment on the line you are reading (or click a changed line's number), A ask, I impact, F focus code. Ctrl+K opens this finder outside editable fields. Back (Alt+←) retraces your reading or exploration steps. Close returns to the view's opener. Escape exits focus mode, clears a highlighted range, or closes an exploration overlay; use Close to close a file in Review. Ctrl+Enter sends a discussion question or saves a line comment.

      Custom review prompts
      
            
        
      
        
      Enabled, approved prompts run automatically on each saved review snapshot. Global prompts apply to every repository. Results are separate from deterministic findings; these checks cannot run tools or edit code.
      
        
      Repository prompts require approval for each revision. Review their instructions before selecting Save and approve.
